sentences.en: They are incredibly soft and stretchy, perfect for yoga, spinning, lifting weights, or doing squats and lunges.

sentences.en: This applies to a wide variety of exercises like dips, pullups, lunges, shoulder presses and more.

sentences.en: Consider doing lunges and other low-impact stretches that elasticize the leg muscles before getting on your rebounding system.

sentences.en: At home, lunges can take the place of the leg extension machine.
sentences.vi: Ở nhà, lunges có thể thay thế cho máy kéo dài chân.

sentences.en: As the person lunges again, the ball is moved to the outside of the other leg.

sentences.en: The dominant leg for the lunge is alternated after a set of lunges is completed.
sentences.vi: Chân thuận cho lunge được thay thế sau khi hoàn thành một tập hợp lung.

sentences.en: Forgiving enough to absorb the lunges of a big carp but with enough reserve to stop fish when needed.
